family.method: All connected branches are included in the family basket. Approved product equivalents preserve food type and total quantities. Choose the reference first, then the first validated equivalent in a fixed published priority. Packaged items use whole packs; pack counts can differ to preserve equal total weight. Weighted fish requires explicit kg source metadata. Never infer missing prices. This curated basket contains frozen fish, frozen vegetables and packaged dates, not fresh meat or fresh fruit/vegetables. The 600-700 ILS target concerns the mean basket value, not each store. Retailer price-file data does not confirm stock.
